notes.title: Jennifer Wilde: Unlikely Revolutionaries - release date confirmed!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce that Jennifer Wilde: Unlikely Revolutionaries will be released on October 18th 2022! 🎉

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39261115/06e5c65e598546ed141a3efdeb249028630a80e5.jpg

We’re so excited to finally share the game with you, and thank you so much to everyone who’s supported us through the development process. We couldn’t have done it without you!

With the finish line in sight, it’s your time to shine! It would really help us if you could share the game on your social media accounts, talk to your friends about it, and generally help us get the word out as much as possible. Don’t worry if you don’t feel you have much of a platform - every little helps!

You can also help support the game in this final stretch by following Outsider Games on social media, if you don’t already. You can find us at the following links:

Twitter: @OutsiderGames
Instagram: @OutsiderGames
Facebook: Outsider Games page
Or join the Discord server here.

We can’t wait to bring Jennifer Wilde into the world, thank you all again for your support.

See you in October 😱🤩

Stephen and the Outsider Games team

notes.title: Jennifer Wilde - Free Demo Update - Kickstarter Half Way point
notes.notes:
Our Jennifer Wilde Kickstarter campaign has 14 days to go and we're 43% of the way to our funding goal.

http://www.outsidergames.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/GIFInventoryWalking.gif

We've updated our free demo with a few tweaks and bug fixes. It's now available via our Kickstarter Page, Gamejolt and itch.io 

While still a work-in-progress, the demo has garnered some great feedback, and already won its first award at the Galway Games gathering for Excellence in Art!

https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/018/504/876/68baad1123b5546dc2ed541f6a8b0c6b_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1506530223&auto=format&lossless=true&s=3740631e46f2af3b08fc509266162b71

We need the support of Wailing Heights' players to fund our spiritual follow-up, so do please check out the  campaign.

notes.title: AGGIE awards, Upcoming Update!
notes.notes:
I know we've been quiet of late, but we've been very noisy behind the scenes prepping our audio remaster. 95% of the files have been reenginered, and we just to need to record a few missing files in order to set the update live. Shouldn't be too long!

In other news, Adventure Gamers placed us Runner Up in their 2016 Aggie awards for Best Gameplay and Best Music, and we placed as a finalist in the first NI Game of the Year awards.
The NI grand prize went to Her Majesty's Spiffing, which is an adventure game from our chums at Billy Goat that I highly recommend while you're waiting to play the remastered Wailing Heights again.

In other news, development is going well on our new project Jennifer Wilde, and I'm sure we'll be teasing a few new images from that soon, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Patch Notes 05.04.2016
notes.notes:
Latest patch includes:

 Song Audio balancing - 'Make it Stick', 'Euphoria' volumes lowered to match surroundings
 Bug Fix - Finale now plays correct songs
 Easier to pick up [spoiler] Spotlight in Souless Saloon [/spoiler] 
 Bat can no longer fly through Town Hall ceiling
 Pre-selected dialogue text is no longer blurry at lower resolutions
 Other small big fixes.

Further dialogue audio level fixes to come.
